description: Full details for one tour: description, stops, meeting spot with map link, duration, difficulty, FAQ, important info, cancellation/weather/age/pet policies and rating. Use for questions like 'how much walking is it?', 'can kids come?' or 'where do we meet?'. Answer only from what this returns; if it doesn't cover a question, give the phone number.

tour.description: Tour identifier from search_tours.tour_id (preferred slug, e.g. 'old-san-juan-ghost-walk'), or the exact tour name.
